Research project / RP / 001OPTINET

Optimal Networks for Control and Optimization

OPTINET

OPTINET aims to answer the question, "what properties of networks make distributed systems resilient? How can you design networks for maximum resilience?". The answer will lie in the intersection of algebraic graph theory, optimal control, and distributed optimization theory.

Contact the project lead

02

Research objectives

Objective 01

Understand the Network

Understand the effect that the network structure has on the underlying physical system in terms of fundamental control-theoretic robustness metrics.

Objective 02

Optimize the Network

Develop algorithm and network co-design methodology to exploit these structures and effects, under control-theoretic robustness metrics, for high-level coordination in distributed systems.

Objective 03

Test the Network

Field-test the algorithms and communication networks in a GNSS-denied environment in Andøya.
